It uses nearly the same operative sentence, opens the same enumerated classes of tax returns to the same House Judiciary Committee and its authorized subcommittees, ties inspection to a committee resolution concerning the administration of the Department of Justice and Office of the Attorney General, and imposes the same Treasury-decision conditions. The child updates the covered period and committee-resolution date, adds a June 30, 1953 sunset, and omits C08's taxpayer-specific written-statement limitation. C03 and C01 share the standard tax-return inspection machinery and close language, but concern different Senate committees and investigations, making them weaker than the same-committee, same-inquiry
